body:
Parent epic: https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/110

## Scope and completion evidence
Prepare one Spectrum lesson sequence sharing reviewed objectives, code/assets, exercises and versions across written, emulator-interactive and short video material. Test captions/transcripts/accessibility and maintenance/correction propagation. Gather actual learner feedback and understanding checks; assess whether video adds measurable value before scaling production.

## Done when
- Results and source/version/environment identities are recorded, with passed/failed/skipped/unknown distinguished.
- Findings are filed as specific follow-up issues or linked to existing ones; no duplicate implementation plan.
- Reviewed findings, limits and next bounded step are linked from this issue.

Maintain existing product architecture and avoid broad rewrites.
title: [Education] Pilot one aligned written, interactive and video tutorial
